name: LVL Up Auto Headless API
description: Token-authenticated (PAT) headless API for a dealership's vendor stack: canonical vendor search, stack management, competitor declarations, domain scans, performance reporting, and k>=5-floored peer benchmarks. All requests are scoped to the token's single rooftop. Note: the token-management endpoints under /api/v1/tokens* (create/list/revoke/update keys and read their activity) are SESSION-authed (browser cookie, owner-only) — NOT PAT-authed — so they are intentionally omitted from this PAT spec; they return the same structured { error: { code, message } } envelope as the operations below.
